name: Love Magic
source: When your grandmother dies, you learn that you are actually a witch! Will you use your magic to get closer to your crush at school? And what about the black cat who keeps following you? Be careful!! You're about to find out that magic brings more problems than it solves...
translation: 当你的祖母去世后，你才知道你实际上是一个女巫！你会用你的魔法来接近你在学校暗恋的人吗？那只一直跟着你的黑猫呢？当心！！你将会发现魔法带来的问题比它解决的问题还要多……
